entities.name: Asetra
entities.description: A powerful Balance host whose emotional attachment to her partner and unborn child led to her being sealed by humanity.
entities.quote: A Balance host who doesn’t want to win. Who still tries to communicate. Who loves humanity. Who gets sealed anyway. That’s tragic myth writing.

entities.name: Nyxia
entities.description: The current Balance host who understands the dark history of her predecessor and chooses restraint over annihilation.
entities.quote: You didn’t turn Nyxia into “humans bad → genocide mode.” You let her see the rot... and still choose restraint.

entities.name: The 9 bloodlines
entities.description: A collective of bloodlines that orchestrated the fear against Asetra and secured power through her sealing.
entities.quote: If 9 clans + multiple species + a Judgement bearer worked together, then what happened likely wasn’t: “We are stronger.” It was: “We are synchronized.”

entities.name: Nilanjonas’ people
entities.description: A powerful, hidden faction that recognized the truth of the Asetra incident but chose strategic non-intervention.
entities.quote: The Observers (Nilanjonas’ people) – Saw the truth. – Declined the war. – Did not intervene. – Preserved themselves.
